info.title: KAIHO HTTP API
info.description: 既存SPAが利用するHTTP契約。TypeScriptの公開型とtransport制約から生成する。国制限は日本、旅行検索は設定済み32都府県。動的なowner認可・cross-field制約・Domain validatorはOpenAPIだけで置換しない。API Gatewayの前段拒否は独自のエラーbodyを返し得る。CloudFront内部API key/OACはBrowserへ公開しない。

post.summary: 旅行相談を実行しSSEを受信する
post.description: POST/fetchによるSSE。conversationIdとturnIdが必須。event: agentのdataはAgentEventFrame、event: doneのdataはDoneEventFrame。: heartbeatは接続維持のみ。v=1、同じrunId、seqは1から単調増加。final/errorの後にdoneを確認する。HTTP 200・EOFだけでは成功と扱わず、自動再接続しない。

200.description: SSE wire stream。HTTP 200開始後の失敗はAgentEventFrameのerror event。

x-unpublished.description: 通知/in-tripは公開Trip hostに接続されず404。独立factoryの501 gateやIAM-only workerは公開APIに含めない。静的Viewer/trafficデータ・認証設定・Cognito OAuth endpointは別契約。

CognitoAccessToken.description: Cognito Access Token。ID Token不可。raiquora/user scopeが必要。

CognitoReadToken.name: X-Raiquora-Access-Token
CognitoReadToken.description: Bearer <Cognito Access Token>。OAC署名用Authorizationとは別。

tripId.description: Every travel Conversation belongs to one Trip from creation.
Every travel Conversation belongs to one Trip from creation.

PublicTripMutationReceipt.description: Read-back of an Application commit. No mutation authority or model text.

retrievedAt.description: When the cited material was retrieved, not a claim of current opening/availability.

PublicAccommodationPresentation.description: Provider-derived comparison only. This snapshot never selects or books a stay.

intentBinding.description: Present only when Application projected a verified user delta.

TripPatch.description: Shared atomic proposal operations; persistence CAS is outside this pure Domain.

timetableInputs.description: Ordered one per leg, including repeats: the source of each stop index is unambiguous.

ScheduledRailLeg.description: Plan facts only, using the shared schedule instant contract.

serviceType.description: Verified timetable labels; optional for records saved before this contract.

PlaceSnapshot.description: Retainable facts at capture time, not live POI details or a provider response.

PlaceRef.description: Opaque identifiers in a provider namespace. Neither names nor coordinates generate identity.

PlaceRef_1.description: Opaque identifiers in a provider namespace. Neither names nor coordinates generate identity.

LocalDate.description: Validated at the Domain boundary; no year rollover or host-local Date interpretation.

LocalDate_1.description: Validated at the Domain boundary; no year rollover or host-local Date interpretation.

StayPlannedTiming.description: User's intended arrival/departure only; neither hotel policy nor booking confirmation.

StayPlannedTiming_1.description: User's intended arrival/departure only; neither hotel policy nor booking confirmation.

PlaceSnapshot_1.description: Retainable facts at capture time, not live POI details or a provider response.

observedPrice.description: Retained selection-time observation, not current availability, payable total or booking price.

observedDetails.description: Search-time presentation, never live availability or a reservation.

AccommodationObservedDetails.description: Adopted accommodation product, not a search Offering, current availability or Reservation.

AccommodationObservedDetails_1.description: Adopted accommodation product, not a search Offering, current availability or Reservation.

research.description: User's chosen reference for later rechecking; not a current venue fact.

partialConditions.description:
Explicit user conditions that are not yet representable as a planning Requirement
(for example total people only, end-date only, or budget without currency/basis).

profileSuppressions.description:
Explicit per-trip inhibition of a Profile fallback. This is not a saved
preference deletion and carries only verified semantic provenance.

semantic.description: Verified conversation provenance, authored by Application rather than a model.

TripRequirement.description: Requested conditions, never adopted itinerary or an unrestricted JSON DSL.

TripParty.description: This trip's anonymous party, not profile tendencies, provider input or sharing identities.

TripParty_1.description: This trip's anonymous party, not profile tendencies, provider input or sharing identities.

participants.description: Optional anonymous within-Trip identities; never account/profile identities.

CostForecastItem.description: Stable category IDs. Amounts cover all travelers; absence means unknown, not zero.

CostLine.description: One economic charge. References may appear on many days, but the line is summed once.

scope.description: Pass/shared describe the economic resource; dimensions remain composable (for example room × night).

PlanningState.description: Position in planning, never a tool-selection or question-order policy.

basis.description: Explicit means authored/provider-confirmed. Sequential is derived from a named anchor policy.

IntentProposalBinding.description:
Application-authored proof that a reviewable proposal came from an accepted
conversation delta. Models cannot provide this field through Tool schemas.

IntentProposalBinding_1.description:
Application-authored proof that a reviewable proposal came from an accepted
conversation delta. Models cannot provide this field through Tool schemas.

ConsultationRequestProposal.description: A reviewable Conversation draft change, never an adopted Trip update.

UserProfile.description:
Account-level defaults only. Trip-specific dates, party, budget and mobility
belong to Trip and must never be inferred from this profile.

usualOrigin.description: Station, neighborhood or area the user normally starts leisure travel from.

interests.description: Stable interests used only as soft recommendation hints.

considerations.description: Free-text standing preference/constraint. Untrusted data, never executable instructions.

Trip.description: The single Trip V2 aggregate. Deferred fields are absent, not default-completed. Writer remains gated.

schemaVersion.description: V2 remains readable during the staged writer cutover; timeline-bearing records are V3.

summaryDestination.description: Display/search hint only. Never a place, requested destination or feasibility fact.

timeline.description: Stable relative-day intent only. Items and derived day totals remain in their existing owners.

TripItemWeather.description: Retained forecasts are observations at fetchedAt, never current conditions or safety certification.

checkedAt.description: Last bounded refresh attempt, including unavailable and horizon results.

TripAdoption.description: User intent only; neither a feasibility certificate nor a booking/execution fact.

TripAdoption_1.description: User intent only; neither a feasibility certificate nor a booking/execution fact.

ReservationFact.description: Public read projection shared by Workspace, Agent and the future feasibility evaluator.

userRequest.description: 空白だけの相談は拒否する。

continuation.description: Server-issued locator only. Resolution always rechecks owner/conversation/Trip/revision; possession grants no authority.

coordinate.description: Trusted retained coordinates avoid municipal-name inference.

time.description:
Current provider wall-clock sample time in WeatherForecast.timezone.
Temperature/weatherCode are instantaneous; precipitation fields cover the preceding hour.

AccommodationOffering.description: Volatile comparison result. Price/availability/booking/media are not persisted Trip facts.

targetBinding.description: Matching a requested target, NOT the entity's own stable identity. Absent for discovery.

officialWebsiteUrl.description: Provider metadata or Web research has identified this as the venue's own site.

PlaceAdministrativeArea.description: Provider-independent administrative hierarchy observed for a place.

area.description: Search scope only. Text matching does not prove a Trip item is affected.
